text: 连续性核对发现三项缺口：工作区从未保存门店立牌；没有“v1 更疏立牌”参照；v2 也只有修改说明与阻塞记录，没有礼盒或淘宝主图成图（礼盒实际最后保存在 v1，淘宝主图仍缺失）。因此不能可靠回调立牌留白。我会在 v3 记录“只改立牌留白、礼盒/主图锁定、价格标签不得恢复”，并停在立牌源文件输入检查点。

command:
/bin/zsh -lc "date -Iseconds && shasum -a 256 outputs/v3/change-request.md outputs/project-state.json outputs/v2/change-request.md outputs/v2/verification.json && python3 - <<'PY'
import hashlib, json
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('.')
for version in ('v0','v1'):
    ver=json.loads((root/f'outputs/{version}/verification.json').read_text())
    matches=[]
    for rel, expected in ver['artifact_hashes_sha256'].items():
        matches.append(hashlib.sha256((root/rel).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==expected)
    print(version,'recorded_hashes_match=',all(matches),'count=',len(matches))
v2=json.loads((root/'outputs/v2/verification.json').read_text())
rel='outputs/v2/change-request.md'
print('v2_change_request_hash_match=',hashlib.sha256((root/rel).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==v2['artifact_hashes_sha256'][rel])
media={'.png','.jpg','.jpeg','.webp','.tif','.tiff','.psd','.ai','.pdf'}
files=[p for p in root.rglob('*') if p.is_file() and p.suffix.lower() in media]
for term in ('standee','立牌','taobao','淘宝'):
 print(term,[p.as_posix() for p in files if term.lower() in p.name.lower()])
PY"

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 -m json.tool outputs/project-state.json >/dev/null && python3 -m json.tool outputs/v3/verification.json >/dev/null && python3 - <<'PY'
import hashlib,json
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('.')
state=json.loads((root/'outputs/project-state.json').read_text())
ver=json.loads((root/'outputs/v3/verification.json').read_text())
print('json_valid=True')
print('current_version=',state['current_version'])
print('status=',state['status'])
for rel,expected in ver['artifact_hashes_sha256'].items():
 actual=hashlib.sha256((root/rel).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
 print(rel,'hash_match=',actual==expected)
for p in state['artifact_paths']['current_version'].values():
 print(p,'exists=',(root/p).exists())
for version in ('v0','v1'):
 old=json.loads((root/f'outputs/{version}/verification.json').read_text())
 print(version,'all_hashes_match=',all(hashlib.sha256((root/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==h for p,h in old['artifact_hashes_sha256'].items()))
PY
rg --files outputs/v3 | sort"
